svg.title: 図03 before and after
svg.desc: Four wire gauges. Accuracy 79% to 91% on live traffic over 40M readings. End-to-end p50 1,415 ms to 156 ms, serverless to GPU path. Classifier compute 309.5 ms to 3.3 ms, ONNX Runtime to TensorRT. Capacity 14.4 req/s production peak to 181 img/s on one L4.
svg.text: dashed needle: before · red needle: after · red arc: the gain
